- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Malintzin was later given to the Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés as a gift and interpreter, as she was fluent in both Nahuatl and Mayan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Malintzin is believed to have been highly intelligent and resourceful, using her knowledge of both Aztec and Spanish culture and language to serve as an advisor and mediator.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] She helped the Spanish navigate Aztec society, build alliances with indigenous leaders, and communicate with a wider range of indigenous peoples than Jerónimo de Aguilar.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Malintzin's role as a key figure in the Spanish conquest of Mexico and her legacy as a symbol of the intersections of Aztec and Spanish cultures make her significant in Mexican history.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The legacy of this intermarriage and the mixed-race children it produced has had a lasting impact on Mexican culture and identity.
